question: PARK is related to QCUM in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, STOP is related to TVRR. To which of the following is RAMP related, following the same logic ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

'PARK' is related to 'QCUM'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5eaf4bd676003f68c2d96b35984e9d6b851f0d0128c7da5417c9d8e9c78a417c.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/16be485253acdb8c58a31595d59e2a55f9ec356c654ecfd09a87a98eab33b6d8.png] 

'STOP' is related to 'TVRR'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/76a396c9c26a0e1e6b9efbe7271a52ec46bab8108eadead74cad10594ae26a4b.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c3bebb7463d7fdd80e9f764e1e8c60a6671a2fd71bc29c11c76dbc9c6bfd63bf.png] 

Similarly, for 'RAMP'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/58cceae833668350561dc6b43d2bcb8dc419e0e20ab5e45831c181c68c2dfefe.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/263f86ca8b2c47b4740f31c63842a54d3642f608659f4d51b85b8ff85735ead1.png] 

So, 'RAMP' is related to '**SCPR**'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.
